chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from his father, who said:

I heard Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام saying: There is no objection to advancing the tawaf of hajj and the tawaf of al-nisa' before the hajj, on the Day of al-Tarwiyah, before his departure to Mina. Likewise, there is no objection for one who fears some matter such that returning to Makkah will not be possible for him, to perform tawaf and bid farewell to the House, then proceed on as he is from Mina, if he is fearful.

Thus, the proper way regarding this report is that we understand it as referring to the compelled person who is not able to return to Makkah, according to what he mentioned in the report. That is not contradictory to the first report, because that one is to be understood as applying to the state of choice.

key_terms.الِاخْتِيَارِ: the state of normal choice, without necessity
key_terms.الْمُضْطَرِّ: the compelled or constrained person facing necessity
key_terms.طَوَافِ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf whose completion is tied to the lawfulness of marital relations after hajj
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْحَجِّ: the circumambulation associated with hajj rites
key_terms.مِنًى: the sacred site to which pilgrims proceed during hajj rites
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah, before departure to Mina

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Tawaf al-Nisa' before going to Mina during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning the timing of tawaf during hajj, especially Tawaf al-Nisa'. It permits bringing forward the tawaf before going to Mina in cases of fear or inability to return to Makkah, while reconciling this with other reports by restricting the permission to cases of necessity rather than normal circumstances.
